newsitem.title: USA: US Plains cattle feeders waiting for $68 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains cattle feeders waiting for $68 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle bids early Wednesday were raised $1.00 per cwt to $67.00, compared with Tuesday but were passed by owners holding out for $68.00, feedlot sources said.
Buying interest was strong, with several cattle feeders saying they've been fielding telephone calls since early in the morning.
"A bid at $68.00 will buy every animal in this yard, but I think we're going to have to wait and see what happens with the board (CME futures) or see who sells first," a Kansas feedlot manager said.
